_title: Hotels Pay 30% to Book Their Own Rooms
_note: EP006, 2026-08-16. OUTCOME-led, replacing the Booking.com-key version: a thumbnail should show what the operator produces, not the tools they use or the incumbent they fight. The frame is the handover — the booking arriving — with the OTA tag set APART rather than severed, because the script's own guardrail is that the honest claim is shifting the mix, never leaving. Booking.com mark dropped: on this tag it renders 20px wide at browse size, so it added noise without adding recognisability. `BOOKED ITSELF` was more clickable and was rejected — the script says someone still has to direct the agents and calls that the line operators underprice, and a thumbnail cannot carry that hedge. The unexpected half lives in the pairing: the title says hotels pay 30% to book their own rooms; this one did not.
